items.title: Derek Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: But of course all the side men have been my friends for years, because they like Frank Foster and Frank Wess — we were all in the studios together playing all these dog food commercials for years.

ctx.x: Have you had occasion to play with the Basie band?

Look, the only time I played with the Basie band, and that’s cheating really, I was accompanying Sammy Cahn who was a songwriter of some repute, and Sam would do an act and get a lot of money for playing this act in various parts of the country. So one day Sam called and he’d say, “oh we’ve got this gig in Chicago.” So I says, “fine.” He says, “it’s with the Basie band.” I said, “what?” He hung up the phone. So we had some arrangements, and I just put them out, and I had to get Count off the piano, raise the…
Most of those guys that did that, were they, that was after they had had the Basie experience, the big band road thing.
